organizational.highlight: Justin taking lead for Besu on Hegota; call cadence moving from bi-weekly to monthly

pq_and_threshold.highlight: PQ threshold encryption off the table: no efficient silent-setup scheme exists; won't be ready for years
Lucid remains PQ-secure but has the optionality problem; focus shifts to mitigating optionality via allowlist

lucid_allowlist_design.highlight: Proposal: validator set votes (by effective balance, 50% threshold) to allowlist trusted key publishers; implemented as EL voting contract
Delegation supported: validators can follow a curated list managed by a delegate rather than maintaining their own
New idea: top-of-block ordering prioritizes allowlisted key publishers over unknown ones (two tiers, not hard rejection); self-reveal still permitted
Two-tier top-of-block lowers market-entry barrier: newcomers can build track record and earn revenue before hitting 50% threshold
Reminder: one commitment in the Lucid EIP must be hiding (needs randomness added); 128x penalty may be reducible if allowlist provides sufficient abuse prevention

eip_updates.highlight: Question raised whether allowlist warrants a separate EIP; consensus is keep as one document for now, split later if needed
Bundles (batching) under reconsideration in Lucid EIP — adds complexity; capital burden may fall on key publishers instead
Hold merge of CL draft spec PR (consensus-specs#5403) until allowlist/in-protocol key publisher decision settles

action_items.action: Open a PR to EIP-8184 capturing allowlist/voting design; Jannik to be added as author
Update Lucid EIP: add randomness to the commitment that must be hiding; review 128x penalty given allowlist mechanism
Leave comment on consensus-specs PR #5403 — hold merge until in-protocol key publisher question is resolved

decisions.decision: Encrypt The Mempool call cadence changed from bi-weekly to monthly
PQ threshold encryption deferred indefinitely; crypto not mature enough
50% of total effective stake as allowlist admission threshold (Schelling point); negative votes not added due to complexity
Allowlist spec kept in one EIP (EIP-8184) for now; split only if it becomes unwieldy
Hold merge of consensus-specs CL draft PR #5403 until allowlist design settles
